verdict.rationale: stagewise has no documented no-training policy or training opt-out. Users can still keep data away from stagewise and third-party model vendors by running self-hosted models via Ollama/LM Studio ('zero external API calls'), by configuring BYOK for every provider so no requests touch the stagewise managed service, or by self-hosting the stagewise Cloud on the enterprise plan. A community user also reported that the dataflow (what gets sent to the LLM) is undocumented, so this protection comes from routing workarounds rather than an explicit guarantee. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that user data or code is not used for training, a training opt-out control for the managed stagewise Account inference, documented data-handling and retention terms, and independent corroboration.
